messages:
Ashley P.: Quick check — listing handoff timetable and creative staging. We need to confirm: 1) press embargo windows per region, 2) hardware partner logo/asset delivery SLA, 3) SI integration docs availability. Goal: go-live in 6 business days.
Devon M.: thanks. can we lock embargo windows today? EU/APAC slots differ. @Nora can legal confirm any embargo constraints?
Nora (Legal): EU prefers local timezone embargo; also need partner sign-off on quoted feature names. suggest formal sign-off by EOD tomorrow.
Samir K.: engineering: SI docs currently at 80% — missing deployment scripts for on-prem kit. ETA 48h if we prioritize.
Li Wei: UI/landing is queued. If we get localized copy + partner logos by tomorrow noon, we can stage localized pages by Thu morning.
Ashley P.: requested partner assets: ask hardware partners for 3 variants (SVG, 2x PNG, and transparent hero). deadline: tomorrow 12:00 PT. @Devon please chase.
Devon M.: on it. drafting chase email now. PSA: press kit will include 1-page solution brief + 2 customer quotes. anyone with quotes?
Samir K.: reached out to SI beta lead; they can provide a short blurb that we can use as a quote — I'll follow up.
deploy-bot: deployment window scheduled: 2026-03-30 02:00 UTC -> 2026-03-30 04:00 UTC (canary first, then full). @Li Wei confirm page cutover script.
Li Wei: confirmed, cutover script ready pending assets.
Ashley P.: Decision points: embargo windows locked today (Devon/Nora), partner assets by tomorrow noon (Devon), SI docs finalization + quote (Samir), localized landing staging (Li). I'll compile a short checklist and share in 1 hr.
Devon M.: locking embargo windows now. FYI, APAC prefers 03:00 UTC slot, EU prefers 08:00 UTC. I'll align with press team.
Nora (Legal): approving embargo windows as proposed. flag: ensure partner logos comply with trademark guidelines (see link: https://docs.redwood.ai/partner-branding)
Ashley P.: thanks. checklist draft: 
```
- Embargo windows: locked (Devon/Nora)
- Partner assets: due TOM 12:00 PT (Devon)
- SI docs + deployment scripts: final TOM+1 10:00 PT (Samir)
- Localized landing pages staged: TOM+2 09:00 PT (Li)
- Press kit + quotes: TOM+2 12:00 PT (Devon/Ashley)
- Cutover & deploy: TOM+3 02:00 UTC (deploy-bot)
```
Ashley P.: If no objections, I'll convert this to a shared Notion page and tag owners. :thumbsup: 
Devon M.: :thumbsup: go ahead.
Samir K.: good to me.
Nora (Legal): approved.
